meta.title: Take full control of your data with Encryption at Rest for Elasticsearch
meta.description: We provide military-grade Encryption at Rest for Elasticsearch, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance with PCI, ISO, SOX and EU regulations. The only standalone plugin that encrypts all Lucene data at its core.
title.headline: Encryption at Rest for Elasticsearch
title.text: Take full control of your data with Encryption at Rest for Elasticsearch indices and snapshots.
concept.headline: Full Data Protection at Rest
concept.text: Encryption at Rest encrypts all Lucene data files, snapshots, and Elasticsearch translog, ensuring your sensitive information remains secure even when stored on disk in public cloud environments.
keys.headline: Your Keys, Your Control
keys.text: With Encryption at Rest, encryption keys are held exclusively in secure memory on cluster nodes and never stored on disk, giving you complete authority over data access and enabling secure data destruction through simple key removal. Encryption operates at the core Lucene level of Elasticsearch, making it impossible to circumvent - your data is protected from the inside out
security.headline: Security Without Compromise
security.text: Encryption at Rest integrates effortlessly with Elasticsearch while maintaining full compatibility with critical features like vector search and k-NN, providing robust security without sacrificing functionality. As a standalone plugin, Encryption at Rest operates independently of any other plugins, giving you maximum flexibility in your security architecture.
compliance.headline: Stay Compliant with Confidence
compliance.text: Meet the stringent requirements of PCI, ISO, SOX, and similar regulations with Encryption at Rest's advanced encryption capabilities, providing the essential documentation and security controls needed for compliance audits.
standards.headline: Meeting Global Security Standards
standards.cyberResilience.headline: European Cyber Resilience Act Compliance
standards.cyberResilience.text: Get ahead of the curve with Encryption at Rest's EU Cyber Resilience Act-ready design. Our cutting-edge encryption and authenticated data structures position you for seamless compliance with European regulations – no last-minute scrambling required!
standards.nist.headline: NIST Framework Alignment
standards.nist.text: Encryption at Rest delivers NIST-aligned protection that security professionals trust. Our encryption technology checks all the right boxes for NIST SP 800-171 compliance, strengthening your security posture with minimal operational overhead.
benefits.headline: Easy Implementation for Any Environment
benefits.container.headline: Container-Ready Security
benefits.container.text: Encryption at Rest installs seamlessly within Docker containers, Kubernetes or on-premise environments, securing your Elasticsearch data with minimal configuration changes to your existing deployment.
benefits.regulatory.headline: Regulatory Compliance Made Simple
benefits.regulatory.text: Supercharge your compliance posture with our military-grade encryption. Even if physical storage is compromised, your data remains locked down tight – giving you confidence and peace of mind.
benefits.platform.headline: Available for Linux, Mac and Windows
benefits.platform.text: Encryption at Rest is platform independent and works on Linux, Mac and Windows. Just download and run it.
